ctx.x: And that was the five of us. After that, the season was finished, we went out to Detroit. We stayed out there in Detroit and I had a chance to see -- bands in the west

at that time had more instruments than the bands in the east. Because we was just beginning to take them on in the east. Because we had so much trouble with the -- oh, on account of the people in the summertime in Atlantic City, they stayed up and there was so many people. The cabarets were right in the neighborhood where some legitimate people lived, you see. And when they raised the windows in the summertime, and you could hear all kinds of noise. So, while I was in Atlantic City, I renewed my friendship with…
